description: Healthy reference state for campus_large, campus_medium grown by a third building and two business VLANs. Eight layer-2 Arista access switches carry ten VLANs (CORP and VOIP in two buildings, BMS, INFRA, GUESTS in two buildings, FINANCE, SERVERS) to a single VyOS firewall: in buildings A and B each bundles an uplink to either aggregate of an MLAG pair, which reaches the firewall's bond0; building C's two hang off a single aggregate on eth8. The firewall is the gateway of every VLAN: it filters between the user groups with intra-zone filtering, holds the DMZ (web, SFTP and DNS segments) and the Internet segment, enforces LAN-to-DMZ and egress policy, masquerades toward the Internet, serves the desks' DHCP reservations and shapes its LAN bundle and trunk. dns-access-4 is the LAN resolver and forwards dmz.lab to dns-dmz, which is authoritative for it. On eth7 the firewall reaches a remote site through router-wan and wan-edge, a Linux router whose eth2 is a 10 Mbit circuit to srv-site, the iperf3 sink. wan-edge:eth2 carries the circuit and no class policy: the link is first come, first served. This is the state assured_bandwidth starts from.
